```{r functions}
run_gsea <- function(dds, condition1, condition2, gmt_path, output_gsea, output_deg) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(DESeq2)
    library(fgsea)
    library(BiocParallel)
    library(dplyr)
  })

  # Force serial execution to avoid BiocParallel crashes
  BiocParallel::register(BiocParallel::SerialParam())

  #-------------------------------
  # 1. Validate contrast levels
  #-------------------------------
  if (!"condition" %in% colnames(colData(dds))) {
    stop("Column 'condition' not found in colData(dds).")
  }

  mut_levels <- levels(dds$condition)

  if (!(condition1 %in% mut_levels)) {
    stop(paste("Condition1 not found in Mutation levels:", condition1))
  }
  if (!(condition2 %in% mut_levels)) {
    stop(paste("Condition2 not found in Mutation levels:", condition2))
  }

  #-------------------------------
  # 2. Run DESeq2 contrast
  #-------------------------------
  res <- DESeq2::results(
    dds,
    contrast = c("condition", condition1, condition2),
    independentFiltering = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.1,
    parallel = FALSE
  )

  # Remove rows with NA statistics
  res <- res[complete.cases(res$stat), ]

  #-------------------------------
  # 3. Build ranking vector
  #-------------------------------
  rnk <- setNames(res$stat, rownames(res))

  if (length(rnk) < 1000) {
    stop("Ranking vector too small (<1000 genes). Likely no signal in this contrast.")
  }

  #-------------------------------
  # 4. Load pathways
  #-------------------------------
  gmt <- fgsea::gmtPathways(gmt_path)

  #-------------------------------
  # 5. Run fgsea
  #-------------------------------
  gsea <- fgsea(
    pathways = gmt,
    stats = rnk,
    minSize = 0,
    maxSize = 500
  )

  gsea_df <- as.data.frame(gsea)
  

  # Flatten list columns (leadingEdge)
  list_cols <- sapply(gsea_df, is.list)
  gsea_df[list_cols] <- lapply(gsea_df[list_cols], function(x) sapply(x, paste, collapse = ";"))

  #-------------------------------
  # 6. Write outputs
  #-------------------------------
  write.csv(gsea_df, output_gsea, row.names = FALSE)

  # DEG table (filtered for significance)
  deg_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    mutate(gene = rownames(res)) %>%
    filter(padj < 0.1)

  write.csv(deg_df, output_deg, row.names = FALSE)

  #-------------------------------
  # 7. Return objects invisibly
  #-------------------------------
  invisible(list(
    gsea = gsea_df,
    degs = deg_df,
    ranking = rnk
  ))
}

EnsIDReplace2 <- function(input, mapping_file = "C:/Users/rohit/OneDrive - Loyola University Chicago/Zhang Lab/Ensembl_labels_human.csv") {
  #-----------------------------
  # 1. Validate inputs
  #-----------------------------
  if (!is.matrix(input) && !is.data.frame(input)) {
    stop("Input must be a matrix or data.frame with rownames.")
  }
  if (is.null(rownames(input))) {
    stop("Input must have rownames corresponding to Ensembl IDs.")
  }
  if (!file.exists(mapping_file)) {
    stop(paste("Mapping file not found:", mapping_file))
  }

  #-----------------------------
  # 2. Load mapping file
  #-----------------------------
  gene_mapping <- read.csv(mapping_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  required_cols <- c("gene_id", "gene_name")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(gene_mapping))) {
    stop("Mapping file must contain columns: gene_id, gene_name")
  }

  #-----------------------------
  # 3. Build lookup vector
  #-----------------------------
  id_list <- setNames(gene_mapping$gene_name, gene_mapping$gene_id)

  #-----------------------------
  # 4. Vectorized name replacement
  #-----------------------------
  old_ids <- rownames(input)

  # Replace Ensembl IDs with gene names where available
  new_names <- id_list[old_ids]

  # For IDs not found in mapping, keep original
  new_names[is.na(new_names)] <- old_ids[is.na(new_names)]

  # Replace empty strings with NA
  new_names[new_names == ""] <- NA

  # Ensure syntactically valid + unique names
  new_names <- make.names(new_names, unique = TRUE)

  #-----------------------------
  # 5. Apply new rownames
  #-----------------------------
  rownames(input) <- new_names

  #-----------------------------
  # 6. Return modified object
  #-----------------------------
  return(input)
}
```


```{r create seurat object}
data_dir <- "D:/Zhang Lab/MDS Project/RNASeq/GSE204845/Data"   # extracted folder

# ---- Sample sheet: prefix = everything before ".barcodes.tsv.gz" ----
meta <- data.frame(
  prefix = c("GSM6198721_MDS01", "GSM6198722_MDS02A", "GSM6198722_MDS02B",
             "GSM6198723_MDS03", "GSM6198724_MDS04", "GSM6198725_MDS05",
             "GSM6198726_MDS06", "GSM6198727_CH01",   "GSM6198728_CH02",
             "GSM7703583_CH03",  "GSM7703588_CH04",
             "GSM7703602_AML01A","GSM7703609_AML01B"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
meta$sample  <- sub("^GSM[0-9]+_", "", meta$prefix)
meta$gsm     <- sub("_.*$", "", meta$prefix)
meta$patient <- sub("[AB]$", "", meta$sample)
meta$disease <- ifelse(grepl("^MDS", meta$sample), "MDS",
                ifelse(grepl("^CH",  meta$sample), "CH", "AML"))

# ---- Generic 10x triplet reader ----
read_triplet <- function(mtx, feat, bc) {
  m     <- readMM(mtx)
  genes <- fread(feat, header = FALSE)
  rownames(m) <- make.unique(if (ncol(genes) >= 2) genes$V2 else genes$V1)
  colnames(m) <- fread(bc, header = FALSE)$V1
  as(m, "CsparseMatrix")
}

# ---- RNA ----
seu_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(meta)), function(i) {
  p <- file.path(data_dir, meta$prefix[i])
  m <- read_triplet(paste0(p, ".matrix.mtx.gz"),
                    paste0(p, ".features.tsv.gz"),
                    paste0(p, ".barcodes.tsv.gz"))
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(m, project = meta$sample[i], min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  obj$sample  <- meta$sample[i]
  obj$patient <- meta$patient[i]
  obj$gsm     <- meta$gsm[i]
  obj$disease <- meta$disease[i]
  obj
})
names(seu_list) <- meta$sample

# QC each sample before merging
seu_list <- lapply(seu_list, function(x) {
  x[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(x, pattern = "^MT-")
  subset(x, subset = nFeature_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA > 1000 & percent.mt < 20)
})
sapply(seu_list, ncol)   # should be a few thousand each, not tens of thousands
gc()

seu <- merge(seu_list[[1]], y = seu_list[-1],
             add.cell.ids = names(seu_list), project = "GSE204845")
seu <- JoinLayers(seu)   # Seurat v5; drop for v4
seu[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, pattern = "^MT-")
table(seu$sample)

# ---- ADT (CITE-seq) for MDS02A, MDS02B, MDS03 ----
adt_meta <- data.frame(
  gsm    = c("GSM7703566", "GSM7703573", "GSM7703578"),
  sample = c("MDS02A", "MDS02B", "MDS03"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

adt_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(adt_meta)), function(i) {
  p   <- file.path(data_dir, paste0(adt_meta$gsm[i], "_", adt_meta$sample[i], ".ADT"))
  mtx <- Sys.glob(c(paste0(p, ".matrix.mtx.gz"), paste0(p, ".mtx.gz")))[1]
  m   <- read_triplet(mtx, paste0(p, ".features.tsv.gz"), paste0(p, ".barcodes.tsv.gz"))
  colnames(m) <- paste0(adt_meta$sample[i], "_", colnames(m))   # match RNA cell names
  m
})

# Check orientation: rows should be proteins (a few dozen), not barcodes
sapply(adt_list, dim)

# Keep only cells present in the RNA object
adt_all <- do.call(cbind, lapply(adt_list, function(m) m[rownames(adt_list[[1]]), ]))
shared  <- intersect(colnames(seu), colnames(adt_all))
length(shared)   # should be thousands; if ~0, barcode formats differ (e.g. "-1" suffix)

seu_cite <- subset(seu, cells = shared)
seu_cite[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = adt_all[, shared])
```

```{r add genotyping}
gt_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.(SF3B1|DNMT3A|U2AF1)\\.tsv\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)

# first existing column from a list of candidate names, else NA
pick <- function(d, opts, na = NA_character_) {
  o <- intersect(opts, names(d))
  if (length(o)) d[[o[1]]] else rep(na, nrow(d))
}

read_gt <- function(f) {
  d <- suppressWarnings(fread(f))
  smp <- sub("^GSM[0-9]+_([A-Za-z0-9]+)\\..*$", "\\1", basename(f))
  data.table(
    sample        = smp,
    mut_gene      = sub(".*\\.(SF3B1|DNMT3A|U2AF1)\\.tsv\\.gz$", "\\1", basename(f)),
    barcode       = d[[1]],
    wt_calls      = as.integer(pick(d, c("WT.calls", "num.wt.calls", "num.wt.calls_10x"), NA_integer_)),
    mut_calls     = as.integer(pick(d, c("MUT.calls", "num.mut.calls", "num.mut.calls_10x"), NA_integer_)),
    total_calls   = as.integer(pick(d, c("Total.calls", "total.calls", "total_10x"), NA_integer_)),
    genotype      = pick(d, c("Genotype", "Genotype_1UMI")),
    genotype_2UMI = pick(d, "Genotype_2UMI"),
    got_celltype  = pick(d, "Cell.Assignment")
  )
}

gt_all <- rbindlist(lapply(gt_files, read_gt))
gt_all[, key := paste0(sample, "_", sub("[-_][0-9]+$", "", barcode))]

# checks
table(gt_all$sample, gt_all$genotype, useNA = "ifany")
sum(duplicated(gt_all$key))     # should be 0

# ---- Add to Seurat ----
cell_key <- sub("[-_][0-9]+$", "", colnames(seu))
idx <- match(cell_key, gt_all$key)

seu$genotype      <- gt_all$genotype[idx]
seu$genotype_2UMI <- gt_all$genotype_2UMI[idx]
seu$mut_gene      <- gt_all$mut_gene[idx]
seu$WT_calls      <- gt_all$wt_calls[idx]
seu$MUT_calls     <- gt_all$mut_calls[idx]
seu$got_celltype  <- gt_all$got_celltype[idx]

# match rate per sample (fraction of RNA cells found in the GoT table)
round(tapply(!is.na(idx), seu$sample, mean), 3)
table(seu$sample, seu$genotype, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r processing}
# one layer per patient
seu_mds[["RNA"]] <- split(seu_mds[["RNA"]], f = seu_mds$patient)
seu_mds <- SCTransform(seu_mds, vst.flavor = "v2", method = "glmGamPoi",
                       vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", variable.features.n = 3000)
seu_mds <- RunPCA(seu_mds, verbose = FALSE)

seu_mds <- IntegrateLayers(seu_mds, method = HarmonyIntegration,
                           normalization.method = "SCT", new.reduction = "int.harmony")

dims <- 1:30
for (r in c("int.harmony", "int.rpca")) {
  seu_mds <- RunUMAP(seu_mds, reduction = r, dims = dims,
                     reduction.name = paste0("umap.", sub("int\\.", "", r)))
}

# compare
p1 <- DimPlot(seu_mds, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "patient")      + ggtitle("Harmony: patient")
p2 <- DimPlot()
p3 <- DimPlot(seu_mds, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "got_celltype", label = TRUE)
(p1 | p3)

seu_mds <- FindNeighbors(seu_mds, reduction = "int.harmony", dims = 1:30)
seu_mds <- FindClusters(seu_mds, resolution = 0.5)
DimPlot(seu_mds, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "genotype")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

expr <- FetchData(seu_mds, vars = c("TBK1", "got_celltype", "genotype", "patient"),
                  assay = "SCT", layer = "data") %>%
  filter(!is.na(got_celltype), !is.na(genotype))

# keep cell types with enough cells
keep_ct <- expr %>% count(got_celltype) %>% filter(n >= 100) %>% pull(got_celltype)

# one value per patient x cell type x genotype (avoids pseudoreplication)
pb <- expr %>%
  filter(got_celltype %in% keep_ct) %>%
  group_by(patient, got_celltype, genotype) %>%
  summarise(TBK1 = mean(TBK1), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n >= 10)

bar <- ggplot(pb, aes(got_celltype, TBK1, fill = genotype)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar",
               position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.8),
             size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(y = "TBK1 (mean SCT-corrected expression per patient)", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
bar
```
